name: Tong · kaptar

method.text: No image file and no 3D model: every frame is drawn on Canvas from code — renderer canvas2d.
The source is 14 files: the scene page, 12 scripts that draw — sky, town, pigeon, boy and props apart, shots 2–5 each in its own file — and the edit.
Five shots, each on its own clock: shots 2–5 run 4 · 4 · 4 · 7.5 s. The film is cut from pieces of them (src/edit.js, edit B).
220 functions: the sky, the town, the pigeon, the boy and each shot are drawn by their own.
7853 lines, the scene page and the edit included.
427 draw calls in the source; offscreen layers are put together with drawImage.

look: Dawn. A violet-blue sky turns pink and peach at the horizon, the sun stands low on the right, the clouds are lit pink from below. The town is a flat, hazy violet silhouette of domes and minarets; in front, a roof, wires and poles, a patterned flag, pigeons on the edge. The boy in a white shirt and a doppi, mostly from behind. Shot 3 is slowed down: dark pigeons in silhouette against an orange sun.

ink: dawn: almost no black, the frame is built of light
value.low: dawn haze: even the darkest place is not black
saturation: the colour of dawn: violet and pink, not black and white
